text: A股三大指数小幅下跌，多只银行股创新高。 恒指半日跌1.3%，恒生科技指数跌2.1%。智谱跌近8%，MINIMAX跌6.7%。 特朗普提议向成年公民发5000美元，前提是共和党继续掌控国会两院。 日本央行审议委员称日本央行将继续上调基准利率，下周加息预期升温。 A股龙头领益智造进入苹果首款折叠屏手机iPhone Duo供应链。 阿布扎比主权财富基金Mubadala通过10亿美元交易入股瑞幸咖啡。
text_en: The three major A-share indices fell slightly, while multiple bank stocks hit new highs. The Hang Seng Index fell 1.3% at midday, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 2.1%. Zhipu dropped nearly 8%, and MINIMAX fell 6.7%. Trump proposed giving $5,000 to adult citizens, provided Republicans continue to control both chambers of Congress. A Bank of Japan Policy Board member said the BOJ will continue to raise its benchmark interest rate, increasing expectations of a rate hike next week. A-share leader Lingyi iTech entered the supply chain for Apple's first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo. Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund Mubadala took a stake in Luckin Coffee through a $1 billion deal.
